title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.22343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. translated_title: GeoState：学习视角解耦的几何状态用于3D世界建模
translated_abstract: 近期的3D世界模型越来越多地使用几何基础模型（GFM）的特征作为预测性世界状态，从而受益于其丰富的几何先验。然而，这些特征的视角相关性使场景动态与相机引起的变化纠缠在一起，导致所得到的状态演化更难以预测。我们提出GeoState，一种用于预测性3D世界建模的视角解耦几何表示，它将场景状态演化与依赖相机的观测分离开来。具体而言，场景分词器将多视角GFM特征聚合为视角解耦的场景状态，几何解码器通过相机射线对其进行查询。随后，自回归世界模型预测未来的场景状态，而相机运动则被单独建模。因此，预测的状态既可以在预测的相机下也可以在外部指定的相机下进行解码，同时在整个滚动预测过程中保持由上下文推导的单一尺度，而无需进行逐帧尺度对齐。
tldr: GeoState提出一种视角解耦的几何状态表示，通过场景分词器聚合多视角几何基础模型特征并将相机运动单独建模，实现了场景动态演化与相机变化的解耦，从而提升3D世界模型状态预测的难度和灵活性。
en_tdlr: GeoState introduces a view-decoupled geometry state representation that aggregates multi-view GFM features via a scene tokenizer and models camera motion separately, disentangling scene dynamics from camera-induced variation for more predictable 3D world modeling.
